origin_lemma.gloss: hardness (of wood); best part; firm, strong; resin, sour cream
origin_lemma.etymology: 13355 sā́ra² (sārá- Pāṇ.) m.n. 'hardness (of wood)' RV., 'best part', adj. 'firm, strong' MBh., 'resin, sour cream' Suśr. [LM 420 separates *sāra- 'whole' from this and equates it with Lat. sōlus, Goth. sēls 'good'. L. A. Schwarzschild JAOS 80, 16 rightly derives mng. 'whole' from 'best part']
